name: OPA2156 / OPA156
type: 36 V CMOS precision RRIO op-amp, dual
tagline: TI's 36 V CMOS rail-to-rail I/O precision dual: 3 nV/√Hz, 25 MHz, 40 V/µs, ±25 µV and 100 mA drive.

lineage.note: Sole source. TI: first of a planned new 36 V RRIO generation. SBOS900 first dated September 2018.

part_numbers.note: SOIC-8 (D) tube / reel. Top marking 'OP2156'. No DIP-8.
Added in Rev B. Orderable suffixes (IDGKR/IDGKT) unconfirmed.
Single unconfirmed. Beware: third-party 'OPA156 JFET Input' documents are an unrelated part.

reputation.summary: Thin, anecdotal praise. diyAudio posters in the OPA1656 thread call its distortion "amazingly good" and better than the OPA1656 in some respects. No ASR or other published measurements. Used mostly in instrumentation (patch-clamp, DAQ) and one DIY preamp output stage. Not a higher-rail OPA1656: both are 36 V; it adds RRI, precision offset and 100 mA drive.
typical_uses: Precision and instrumentation front ends (patch-clamp, DAQ)
DIY audio preamp output or buffer stage
OPA1656-class swap needing RRI, low offset or 100 mA
caveats: Not audio-branded; no audio THD+N measurements found.
SMD only (SOIC-8, VSSOP-8); DIP socket rolling needs an adapter.
Same 36 V limit as the OPA1656, so no supply-headroom advantage.
Praise is a handful of forum remarks; tier C rests mostly on specs.

counterfeit_notes: No reports. Modern SMD-only TI part without the cult following that drives relabeling, so risk is presumably low; buy authorized. OPA2156ID top marking is 'OP2156'. 'OPA156' hits on digchip and datasheetarchive are an unrelated JFET part.

revision_history.changes: Pre-production (Product Preview / Advance Information) edition, SOIC-8 (D) only. Inferred from Rev A change log; no copy found.
First production-data data sheet, still SOIC only. Chinese counterpart ZHCSIQ3A (Dec 2018).
Added DGK (VSSOP) package; noise plot (Fig. 8) extended to 10 MHz; Ib/Ios curves (Figs. 12–14) marked SOIC. Chinese ZHCSIQ3B.

open_questions: Does a single OPA156 exist? No TI product page or orderable code was found.
Datasheet quiescent current per channel, minimum supply, current noise and THD+N. One third-party design budgets 4.4 mA.
What are the VSSOP-8 orderable codes (OPA2156IDGKR / IDGKT)?
Any PCN or silicon change? TI's PCN database not searched; Digi-Key PCN20240701000/PCN20240902002 cover other parts (SBOS058A→B).
Do OPA2156 and OPA165x share a process? Only hint: consecutive literature numbers SBOS900/SBOS901.

refuted_claims: 'Higher-rail alternative to the OPA1656': both are 36 V (OPA1656 is 4.5–36 V per SBOS901C); OPA2156 adds RRI, precision offset and 100 mA drive.
'No hi-fi community praise found': diyAudio OPA1656-thread posts praise the OPA2156's distortion.
Datasheet title 'OPAx156': the TI title names only OPA2156; no evidence it covers a single OPA156.
~14 µV typical Vos estimate from the PSpice model is superseded by the datasheet's ±25 µV typ.
corrections: Added SBOS900A (Sept 2018, revised Dec 2018); Rev B (June 2019) is the latest seen, no Rev C found.
